summary: Revised Master Implementation Plan: Enforces complete app-wide rollout of the medical-style squircle button in brand terracotta (#C4785A) with ambient glow, universal adoption of the kinetic expanding Seek search bar across all 16 verticals, modular deconstruction of the 8 expansion categories into dedicated screens to eradicate double navigation, and comprehensive form upgrades to kinetic LabelInput and LabelSelect.
